insights.lead: Two practical articles to help you understand your home before you talk to a designer.
insights.a1: Read sun and wind before planning layout
insights.a1s: How to observe sun and wind on the plot before laying out rooms.
insights.a2: What to prepare before your first design call
insights.a2s: A list of the information and photos to prepare. You do not need drawings yet.

sun.lead: A home that feels hot, stuffy or dark often starts with the plan. Reading the sun and wind of the plot before drawing helps you place rooms, openings and shading in the right spots.
sun.s1t: 1. Find the direction of the plot
sun.s1p: Know which way the street side faces, and what the other sides border: neighbouring houses, an alley, open space or a large tree.
sun.s2t: 2. Watch the sun at different times
sun.s2p: Visit the plot in the morning, at midday and in the afternoon. Note where the sun falls, where neighbouring houses or trees block it, and where the afternoon sun enters the house.
sun.s3t: 3. Find where wind enters and leaves
sun.s3p: A well-ventilated home needs a way in and a way out for the wind, often the front door, a light well or a void, and a rear opening. Long tube houses need this most.
sun.s4t: 4. Place rooms by sun and wind
sun.s4p: Rooms used for long hours should have natural light and ventilation. Service areas, storage and the stair can sit on the harshest side.
sun.s5p: Vertical fins, eaves, planting or solid screens can shade the house and still let air through. Choose per facade, not one answer for the whole house.
sun.noteT: What this article does not promise
sun.noteP: We do not give savings figures or a specific temperature change. This is a way of observing so the design has reasons. Sun and wind analysis is part of all three ECO ARCH packages.

call.lead: The first call is free and shorter when you have a few details ready. You do not need drawings yet.
call.s1p: District, ward or address. A full address is not needed yet.
call.s2t: Photos of the plot or home
call.s2p: A few photos from outside to inside and of the neighbouring sides, if you have them.
call.s3p: The building type, who lives there, and what you like and dislike about the current home.
call.s4p: When you would like to start. It is fine if you are not sure.
call.s5p: ECO ARCH replies within 24 hours to arrange a call.
